protocol_metadata.about: Curve LlamaLend (Curve Lend) is a permissionless lending protocol built on the LLAMMA (Lending-Liquidating AMM Algorithm) mechanism, where users can borrow stablecoins (crvUSD) or other assets against collateral without the collateral being rehypothecated. Markets are created through a factory contract deploying isolated controller, AMM, vault, and oracle contracts per market pair. The soft-liquidation mechanism converts collateral gradually into the borrowed asset as health declines, reducing hard-liquidation risk compared to traditional lending protocols. The protocol is deployed on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Fraxtal, and Optimism, governed by Curve DAO via on-chain voting with an emergency multisig backstop.
